SELECT i.id AS invoice_id, i.amount, i.status AS invoice_status, i.due_date, i.paid_date,
       p.id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.status AS project_status, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.budget,
       c.id AS client_id, c.name AS client_name, c.industry, c.region, c.contract_value
FROM invoices i
JOIN projects p ON i.project_id = p.id
JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
